fractional_orders.detail: A quantity 0.01 market and limit probe was rejected with /api-errors/min-quantity-exceeded for NOA3d_EQ. The tested account/instrument profile therefore cannot claim fractional support.

market_orders.detail: BUY order 57500060549 filled for 1 share at EUR 7.65; SELL order 57500060557 filled for 1 share at EUR 7.642. The position and pending-order endpoints were flat after cleanup.

native_stop_limit_orders.detail: A sell STOP_LIMIT for -1 share at stop/limit EUR 0.01 was accepted as order 57500060555 and cancelled before it could trigger.

protective_orders.detail: Trading 212 exposes standalone STOP and STOP_LIMIT orders, but the public API does not expose an atomic bracket/OCO or attached-protection request. The application requires attached, position-bound protection, so native stop acceptance is not promoted to entry protection.

quotes.detail: The official v0 OpenAPI path inventory has account, position, metadata, order and history families but no quote/bid/ask endpoint. Position valuation and fill prices are not executable bid/ask quotes; a separate approved feed remains required.

cross_currency_market_orders.detail: AAPL_US_EQ BUY order 57500062513 and SELL order 57500062553 both filled; wallet impact reported EUR values and FX rates 1.11903552 and 1.1193226.
